name: 55 Bunch
description: A primarily Mexican-American street gang based on the Eastside of South Central Los Angeles, controlling territory near Main Street between 54th and 58th Streets. A Sureño-aligned gang affiliated with the Mexican Mafia, with cliques including the Locos (LCS), Juveniles (JVLS), Winos (WNS), and Bagos (BGS). Allied with the Hang Out Boys (HOB); rivals of the Playboys 13, 41st Street Gang, 42 Lil Criminals, Barrio Mojados 13, and the 50th Street Gang.
